inputProvenanceAudit.structuralCashFlowLimitation: Structural Omission: Synthetic Total Cash Value formula adds only single-year annual dividend (illTotalCV = Guaranteed + Annual(y) + Terminal(y)), discarding historical dividend accumulation from years 1..y-1. Intermediate annual dividends were unaccumulated and unpaid in cash flow vectors.
inputProvenanceAudit.truthDisclosure: Cash-value tables in scripts/independent_irr_recomputation.js were generated from procedural polynomials, not official benefit illustrations. The engine proved internal consistency against synthetic tables, not empirical truth.

benchmarks.name: 5-Year Level Ordinary Annuity (End-of-Year Inflow)
benchmarks.analyticFormula: PV = PMT * [1 - (1+r)^-n] / r at r = 4.500000% (guess=10% traversal)

benchmarks.name: 5-Year Level Annuity-Due (Advance Premium / Maturity Lumpsum)
benchmarks.analyticFormula: FV = PMT * [((1+r)^n - 1) / r] * (1+r) at r = 6.000000% (guess=2% traversal)

bugPostmortem.bugDescription: In Cycle 2 of Run 1, the IRR cash-flow array length was indexed to T instead of T+1, discounting the terminal surrender cash value at t = T-1 instead of t = T.
bugPostmortem.economicImpactFormula: Duration-Dependent Inflation Formula: r_flawed = (1 + r_true)^(T / (T-1)) - 1. For short tenors (T=2), inflation is catastrophic (+525 bps on a 5% true rate); for medium tenors (T=5), inflation is +130 bps; for long tenors (T=30), inflation drops to +18 bps. The previous report generalized this as a flat ~0.90%, obscuring the tenor sensitivity.
bugPostmortem.whyEarlier207TestsMissedIt: The earlier 207 tests suffered from an Engine Self-Matching Blindspot: tests evaluated whether app components agreed with hardcoded snapshots that were generated by the engine itself, rather than asserting against analytic closed-form ground truth.

remainingBlindspotClasses.bugClass: Non-Conventional Cash Flows & Multiple Real IRR Roots (Descartes' Rule of Signs)
remainingBlindspotClasses.mechanism: When policies feature living cash coupons, periodic annuity withdrawals, or rider fee deductions, cash flow signs alternate multiple times (-, +, -, +). By Descartes' Rule of Signs, multiple positive real IRR roots exist. Standard Newton-Raphson converges arbitrarily to one root near its guess, hiding other valid internal rates of return (MIRR should be used).
Real policies allow monthly/quarterly payments with modal loading factors (e.g. 0.09 x annual), altering intra-year compounding. The engine models annual lump sums only.

remainingBlindspotClasses.bugClass: Stateful Policy Loan & Partial Surrender Sequencing
remainingBlindspotClasses.mechanism: Taking a policy loan reduces future dividend accrual non-linearly. Static cash flow vectors cannot capture dynamic path-dependent balances.

remainingBlindspotClasses.bugClass: Terminal Bonus Smoothing Volatility & Discretionary Cuts
remainingBlindspotClasses.mechanism: Terminal bonuses are non-guaranteed and determined annually by insurer appointed actuaries. Unit tests assume smooth deterministic curves; they cannot predict discretionary board cuts during market stress.

remainingBlindspotClasses.bugClass: Statutory Tax Clawback on Early QDAP Surrender
remainingBlindspotClasses.mechanism: Under Cap. 112 Section 26ZZD, premature surrender triggers retroactive tax clawbacks. The engine calculates gross surrender value without modeling personal tax deductions.
